title: ClanWarz
wikitext:
Polish 4on4 league tournament founded in 2010.

Clan Warz Poland is the first edition of The Polish 4/4 Teamplay event. The project has been under construction and heated debate for weeks which now have born some fruit. Althought the term "Polish" may be deceiving as you are perfectly welcome to register your EU clans! We are dying to face your deadly shafts in the league. Hopefully, the fact that the league will be held mainly at the Polish servers will not be off-putting. Show your skills and courage and sign up now!
